$comment: YAMS conformance suite. Every implementation should produce the stated outcome for every case. Paths are relative to this file.

cases.exercises: The smallest well-formed document: schema, nodes, connections. No catalog declared.

A document declaring a catalog and a name, with params on nodes. Also covers unknown-key handling: the object-form param carries a `curve` key the specification does not define, which a reader must ignore and a writer must preserve on round-trip.
Broad surface — the round-trip case. Parse, re-serialise, re-parse, and the two parses must be equal.
Tab characters used for indentation. YAML forbids tabs in indentation; Safe YAMS rejects them outright rather than relying on the YAML parser's error.
A YAML anchor (&anchor). Anchors and aliases are excluded from the Safe YAMS subset — they let one document expand unboundedly and defeat diff-readability.
YAML 1.1 boolean spelling (yes). Safe YAMS admits only true/false, so a value like `yes` or `on` is never silently coerced to a boolean.
A connection whose source node id does not appear in nodes. Parses as well-formed YAML; fails structural validation.
The same from/to pair declared twice with differing atten. Ambiguous by construction — the format does not define which wins.
